messages:
Jia: Heads up — 7th & Market turned into a splash zone this morning. Bike shoes still drying. anyone else? :umbrella:
Marco: yep. water came up to my chain. bike is squeaking like a haunted xylophone. :sweat_smile:
Devon: lol. same. dodged a puddle and found a tiny river instead. Muni bus 19 was 20 mins late and full.
CommuterBot: Service alert: Muni bus 19 — delays due to roadway flooding near Market St and 7th St. Estimated delay: 15-25 minutes. https://sfmta.link/alerts
Elaine: is the office shuttle still running from Embarcadero or should I Uber?
Marco: Shuttle ran but they routed around Folsom, so added ~10m. if you can wait, it's cheaper than paying surge.
Riley: if anyone's headed toward SoMa and has room for a small commuter-bike, I can hop on — my tire is fussy after the splash. :biking_man:
Jia: @Riley you saved my morning last week. I'm on my way from Rincon, will check if there's space and DM you.
Devon: PSA — left a spare cheap umbrella on the communal shelf by the kitchen (second peg). it's not pretty but it works. :thumbsup:
Elaine: thank you!!! I swear I buy umbrellas and they disintegrate instantly.
Marco: also saw a small pileup of bikes by the north-side rack — one bent fender, someone patching tubes with what looked like tape and optimism. :joy:
CommuterBot: Weather update: light showers through 10:30am, heavier bursts possible 11am-1pm. Consider waterproof layers.
Jia: office check — is anyone planning to go remote this afternoon if the rain keeps up?
Riley: might WFH after lunch unless the sky clears. bike + soggy roads = no thanks.
Devon: staying in for a video deep-dive with a dry chair. can take incoming bug triage if needed.
Elaine: quick poll: who wants the extra umbrella on the kitchen peg? React with :raised_hand: and I’ll leave it by the door for pickup.
Marco: :raised_hand:
Jia: :raised_hand:
Riley: :raised_hand: (if it's still there at 12:30)
Devon: thanks everyone — sending a tiny meme in #random (measured in kilolols) about bikes vs puddles.
Jia: lol, needed that. ok heading in, will bring duct tape for the optimist patch job. :wrench:
CommuterBot: Reminder: if you report transit incidents, include time and location for faster escalation. Report here: https://internal.redwood/transit-reports
Elaine: Timestamps: left Apt at 8:05, hit splash at 8:28 at 7th & Market. posted a photo in thread (phone soggy but survived).
Riley: update for @Devon — there's room on the south shuttle at 8:50, ping me if you want a spot.
Devon: Taking it, thx!
Jia: morning rescue mission successful. bike survived, shoes less confident. See y'all in the dry side of the office. :coffee:
